problem: The candidate enforces exactly four calculation cases but does not enforce that the bow length is divided into four equal-length subregions. Four cases alone permits unequal subregions and therefore does not encode the stated equal-division requirement.
required_change: Add an explicit, executable equal-subdivision constraint relating the four bow subregions to nltl:bowLength, including the required subregion lengths or equivalent canonical positional relationships.
regression_guard: Preserve exactly four calculation cases and their midpoint calculation data while enforcing equal subdivision of the bow length.
